findings.detail: NativeNews ignores id/search and renders same TrendsPage; alias does not establish article detail coverage
EaselAuth is reachable through lazy named export in NativeHost auth; must not be excluded
New poster/article routes prepare original native ChatPage; unmounted Production export excluded only, not WorkCanvas
Automatic publishing guarded by policy; current private manual policy means gated official path not claimed as private tested
Source cross-check with shared accounts service confirms retained AppID dialog has no reachable private click path; classified explicitly rather than fabricated coverage.

Original TEMP Auth stub predates image_delivery signed URLs; new fixture supplies actual lock/session table keyed by token_hash, without media route mock or authorization bypass. Previous broken-image screenshots are rejected evidence.
Actual sandbox HTML iframe blocked by global X-Frame-Options DENY in frozen backend163155; root owns isolated preview-response policy fix and a new frozen backend is required.
r2 long-title day-view event rows expand to ~1900px inside narrow modal; CSS owner notified; current r2 reports rejected pending correction.
Settings /settings?panel=model Escape stays at /settings rather than dismissing whole settings
Experience native dialog Escape recurses through route layer closure and throws maximum call stack
Visible pre overflow expands .chat-messages to1881px and actual media scrollIntoView shifts all chat text left23px
